sentences.text:
Office Notes, Office Memoranda of Court's or Judge's Order
 Coram, appearances, Court's Orders
 or directions and Registrar's order
 Mr. P.S. Dhenge, counsel for applicant.
 Ms. M.A.Barbde, App for non-applicant/State.
 Coram : Urmila Joshi-Phalke, J.
Dated : 09/07/2025.
1.

Apprehending the arrest at the hands of police in connection with Crime No. 134 of 2025
registered with police station Rajapeth, District Amravati for the offence punishable under Sections
406, 420 read with Section 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, the applicant approached this
Court for grant of pre-arrest bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, who submitted that as far as the allegation against the present applicant is concerned, which states that co- accused lured the various investors to invest the amount, and accordingly the investors have invested the amount, and some amount is also paid to the present applicant to invest it in daily needs and financial services.
From the recitals of the FIR, except the stray sentence, there is nothing on record that how much amount is paid to the present applicant and when it was rkn 2 908aba502.2025.odt paid.
Thus, considering the role attributed to the present applicant, her custodial interrogation is not required, and therefore, she be protected by granting ad-interim protection.

3. Learned APP strongly opposed the said application and invited my attention towards the recitals of the FIR and submitted that as per the allegation levelled in the FIR, the amount of Rs.
20,00,000/- was paid to the present applicant and the other co-accused, and therefore, her custodial interrogation is required.
4. On hearing both sides and on perusal of the investigation papers, general allegations is levelled against the present applicant.
As far as the immediate custodial interrogation is concerned, which is not required, in view of that, she can be protected by granting ad-interim protection.
Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following order.

b] Learned Additional Public Prosecutor waives service of notice on behalf of non- applicant/State and seeks time to file reply.

c] In the event of arrest in connection with Crime No. 134 of 2025 registered with police station Rajapeth, District Amravati rkn 3 908aba502.2025.odt for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 420 read with Section 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, the applicant - Pratibha w/o Sanjay Dahake shall be released on ad-interim anticipatory bail on executing P.R. Bond of Rs.
25,000/- with one solvent surety in the like amount.
d] The applicant shall attend the concerned police station once in a week on Monday between 10.00 a.m. to 01.00 p.m. and shall cooperate with the investigating agency.
e] The applicant shall not induce, threat or promise any witnesses who are acquainted with the facts of the present case.
f] The applicant shall not leave the jurisdiction of the Amravati district without prior permission of the District Court Amravati.
g] The applicant shall furnish her detail address along with the address proof and she shall surrender her passport, if she is having before the investigating agency.
rkn 4 908aba502.2025.odt h]
The contravention of any of the condition would lead to the cancellation of bail.

5. Stand over after two weeks.
